verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents SSO so employees can sign in once across managed cloud apps (google-workspace-docs-2, google-workspace-docs-18) and an app marketplace for connecting business apps (google-workspace-docs-10), which supports the single-sign-on aspect of the story. However, there is no evidence of an employee-facing launcher dashboard UI or a browser extension surfacing assigned apps in one place. missing for 10: evidence of an actual launcher/app-grid dashboard, evidence of a browser extension for quick app access, and confirmation that assigned apps are surfaced per-user rather than just admin-configured SSO.
